references.text: Adoni-Bezek is mentioned here as one of the kings whom Joshua defeated, showing the broader context of Israel's conquest of Canaan.
Describes the Canaanites and Perizzites as enemies Israel had to fight during the conquest of the promised land.
The Perizzites are mentioned along with other nations living in the land that Israel was to take over.
God's promise to drive out the Canaanites and Perizzites from the land ahead of the Israelites.
The Canaanites and Perizzites are mentioned among the peoples God would drive out from the land.
The Perizzites and Canaanites are among the seven nations Israel was to drive out of Canaan.
The first time the Canaanites and Perizzites are mentioned together as inhabitants of the land.
